scripts.studio: npm run audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts ByeDemoReel out/bye-demo-reel.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac
scripts.optimize: ffmpeg -y -i out/bye-demo-reel.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset veryslow -crf 26 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -tune animation -c:a aac -b:a 64k -movflags +faststart out/bye-demo-reel.min.mp4 && mv out/bye-demo-reel.min.mp4 out/bye-demo-reel.mp4
scripts.still: npm run audio && remotion still src/index.ts ByeDemoReel out/bye-demo-reel-poster.png --frame=1000
